subject: maths
title: Primary 1 2D Shapes
seo_title: P1 2D Shapes Worksheets: Free Primary 1 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Identifying, naming, describing and classifying 2D shapes (rectangle, square, triangle, circle, half circle, quarter circle); forming figures; copying figures on grids
meta_desc: Free P1 maths practice: name 2D shapes, count sides and corners, half and quarter circles, make figures and copy them on a dot grid. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Count the straight sides and the corners to name a shape. Turning a shape never changes its name.
key_sub: A half circle has 1 straight side. A quarter circle has 2. A square on its corner is still a square.
body_html:
Six shapes to know

Look at the sides and the corners. A side can be straight or curved.

ShapeStraight sidesCurved sidesCorners
Rectangle4 (2 long, 2 short)04
Square4 (all the same length)04
Triangle303
Circle010
Half circle112
Quarter circle213

Size, colour and turning do not change the name.

Example 1

A shape has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. What is it?

A half circle has only 1 straight side. 2 straight sides and 1 curved side make a quarter circle.

Answer: a quarter circle

Half circles and quarter circles

Cut a circle into 2 equal parts. Each part is a half circle. Cut it into 4 equal parts. Each part is a quarter circle. The cuts must go through the middle.

Example 2

How many quarter circles make a half circle?

2 quarter circles fit together to make a half circle.

Answer: 2

Shapes make figures

We can put shapes together to make a figure. Count each kind of shape. Point to each one as you count.

Example 3

2 squares are put side by side. What shape do they make?

The new shape has 2 long sides and 2 short sides.

Answer: a rectangle

Copy a figure on a dot grid

Start at one corner. Count the spaces between dots along each side. Draw the same number of spaces in your copy.

Example 4

A side of the figure joins 4 dots in a row. How many spaces long is it?

4 dots in a row have 3 spaces between them.

Answer: 3 spaces

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Calling a turned square a “diamond”Check the sides. 4 sides the same length and 4 square corners make a square, any way up.
Mixing up a half circle and a quarter circleCount the straight sides. A half circle has 1. A quarter circle has 2.
Calling a quarter circle a triangleA triangle has 3 straight sides. A quarter circle has a curved side.
Calling any 2 parts of a circle half circlesHalf circles are 2 equal parts. The cut goes through the middle.
Missing a shape in a figurePoint to each shape as you count. Look in the middle too.
Counting dots instead of spacesOn a dot grid, count the spaces between the dots.

faq.q: What 2D shapes are taught in Primary 1 maths?
faq.a: Primary 1 students in Singapore learn the rectangle, square, triangle, circle, half circle and quarter circle. They name and describe the shapes, use them to make figures, and copy figures on a dot grid.

faq.q: What is the difference between a half circle and a quarter circle?
faq.a: A half circle is 1 of 2 equal parts of a circle and has 1 straight side. A quarter circle is 1 of 4 equal parts and has 2 straight sides that meet at a square corner.

faq.q: Is a square turned on its corner still a square?
faq.a: Yes. It still has 4 sides of the same length and 4 square corners. Many children call it a “diamond”, but turning a shape never changes its name.

faq.q: How can I help my child copy figures on a dot grid?
faq.a: Ask your child to start at one corner and count the spaces between the dots along each side. Then check the copy side by side with the figure, one side at a time.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It is round. It has no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are the same length. It is a square.

items.q: Which shape is a triangle?
items.e: C has 3 straight sides. It points down. It is still a triangle. The quarter circle has a curved side.
It is a quarter of a circle. It has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is a quarter circle. It is turned. It is still a quarter circle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 sides are short. It is a rectangle. It is tilted. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are the same length. It is a square. It is small and turned. It is still a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 sides are short. It is a rectangle. It is standing up. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are the same length. It is a square. It stands on a corner. Some children say “diamond”. It is still a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It is round. It has no corners. It is a circle. It is small. It is still a circle.
It is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle. It is turned. It is still a half circle.

items.q: I have 3 straight sides and 3 corners. What am I?
items.e: A triangle has 3 straight sides. A quarter circle has only 2 straight sides.

items.q: I have 4 straight sides. 2 are long and 2 are short. What am I?
items.e: A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. A square has 4 sides the same length.
There is 1 square corner and 2 corners at the ends of the curved side. 1 + 2 = 3 corners.
A half circle has 1 straight side. The other side is curved.
B is a circle. It has no corners. The half circle has 2 corners.
A half circle has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. A quarter circle has 2 straight sides.
Look for 3 straight sides. There are 3 triangles. The quarter circle has a curved side, so it is not a triangle.
A circle is round all the way. A half circle has 2 corners.

items.q: How many straight sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count the sides: 1, 2, 3. A triangle has 3 straight sides.

items.q: How many corners does a circle have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way. It has no corners: 0.

items.q: How many straight sides does a quarter circle have?
items.e: A quarter circle has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side.

items.q: Which shape is the odd one out?
items.e: D has 4 sides. It is a square. The others have 3 sides. They are triangles.

items.q: How many corners does this square have?
items.e: Count the corners: 1, 2, 3, 4. A square has 4 corners, even when it is turned.
The corners are where the straight side meets the curved side. There are 2 corners.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count the corners: 1, 2, 3, 4. A rectangle has 4 corners, even when it is tilted.
A quarter circle has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a square?
items.e: C has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle. The squares are turned, but all their sides are the same.
A circle, half circles and a quarter circle. Each one has a curved side.

items.q: These shapes are in one group. What is the same?
items.e: Some are squares. Some are rectangles. The colours and sizes are different. All of them have 4 corners.
A is a quarter circle. It has a curved side and 3 corners. The triangle has no curved side.
A circle is 2 half circles. Ethan has 1. 2 − 1 = 1 more.
C has 1 straight side. It is a half circle. Each quarter circle has 2 straight sides.

items.q: Hafiz cuts a round pizza into 4 equal slices. What shape is each slice?
items.e: A circle cut into 4 equal parts gives 4 quarter circles. Each slice is a quarter circle.
D has a square corner and a curved side. It is a quarter circle. The triangle has 3 straight sides.

items.q: Which circle is cut into 2 half circles?
items.e: In B the line goes through the middle. The 2 parts are equal. The other cuts make parts that are not equal, or 4 parts.

items.q: This circle is cut into 4 equal parts. What is each part?
items.e: 4 equal parts of a circle are 4 quarter circles. A quarter circle has a curved side, so it is not a triangle.

items.q: Priya cuts a round pancake into 2 equal parts. What shape is each part?
items.e: A circle cut into 2 equal parts gives 2 half circles.
The 2 straight sides meet. The new shape has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle.
A quarter circle has 2 straight sides and a square corner. There are 3 quarter circles.
4 quarter circles fit together to make 1 circle.
Half of a half circle is a quarter circle.

items.q: Which circle is cut into 4 quarter circles?
items.e: In A both lines go through the middle. The 4 parts are equal. They are quarter circles.
A half circle is 2 quarters of a circle. 2 quarter circles make a half circle.
1 half circle + 1 half circle = 1 circle. 2 half circles make a circle.
The 2 straight sides meet in the middle. The new shape is round all the way. It is a circle.
A is half of a circle, upside down. It has 1 straight side and 1 curved side.
A half circle has 1 straight side. There are 3 half circles. The others are quarter circles and a circle.

items.q: Ahmad cuts a circle like this. Are the 2 parts half circles?
c: No, the parts are not equal
items.e: Half circles are 2 equal parts. The line does not go through the middle. One part is bigger.
B has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is a quarter circle. The half circles have only 1 straight side.

items.q: This circle is cut into 2 equal parts. What is each part?
items.e: 2 equal parts of a circle are 2 half circles.

items.q: Which figure uses 3 triangles?
items.e: A is the rocket. It has 1 triangle at the top and 2 at the bottom. That is 3 triangles.

items.q: How many small triangles make this big triangle?
items.e: There are 3 small triangles pointing up. Do not miss the one in the middle. It points down. 3 + 1 = 4.

items.q: How many small squares make this big square?
items.e: There are 3 rows. Each row has 3 squares. 3 + 3 + 3 = 9. Do not miss the one in the middle.

items.q: Devi makes a robot with shapes. How many shapes are there in all?
items.e: Head 1, body 1, arms 2, legs 2. 1 + 1 + 2 + 2 = 6 shapes.

items.q: How many triangles are in this sun?
items.e: Count the points around the circle. Each one is a triangle. There are 6 triangles.

a triangle and a quarter circle
items.e: The cone has 3 straight sides. It is a triangle. The top has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle.

items.q: What shape do these 2 triangles make?
items.e: Together they have 4 sides the same length and 4 square corners. They make a square.

items.q: How many small triangles make this kite?
items.e: The 2 lines cross in the middle. They make 4 small triangles.

items.q: Chloe cuts a rectangle along the line. How many triangles does she get?
items.e: The line goes from corner to corner. It makes 2 triangles.

items.q: Raju makes a rocket with shapes. How many triangles are there?
items.e: The tip is 1 triangle. There are 2 more at the bottom. 1 + 2 = 3 triangles.

a half circle and a triangle
a half circle and a rectangle
items.e: The top has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle. The handle is a thin rectangle.
The boat is a half circle, the pole is a thin rectangle and the sail is a triangle. There is no circle.

items.q: How many circles make this caterpillar?
items.e: Count the round parts: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. There are 5 circles.

items.q: Ryan makes a train. How many circles does he use?
items.e: The wheels are circles. Count them: 4 circles.

items.q: Farah puts 2 squares side by side. What shape does she make?
items.e: The new shape has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle, not a square.
There is 1 half circle on each side of the square. There are 4 half circles.

items.q: Wei Ming makes a house. Which 2 shapes does he use?
items.e: The wall has 4 sides the same length. It is a square. The roof has 3 sides. It is a triangle.

items.q: Jun Jie draws a tree. Which 2 shapes does he use?
items.e: The top has 3 straight sides. It is a triangle. The trunk has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle.
B is the ice cream. The cone is a triangle and the top is a half circle.
D is the sun. Its middle is a circle. The boat, the ice cream and the flower use half circles, not circles.

sets.title: Copy and complete figures on a dot grid

items.e: The figure goes 3 spaces down and 2 spaces across. Only B matches.

items.q: Xin Yi draws 2 sides of a square. Which dot finishes the square?
items.e: Join both ends to dot B. All 4 corners are square corners and all 4 sides are the same length.

items.q: Nurul draws a house on dot paper. Which 2 shapes make it?
c: a square and a half circle
items.e: The bottom is 2 spaces each way. It is a square. The roof has 3 straight sides. It is a triangle.
In C every side is as long as in the figure. In the others one side is too long or too short.
The top of the figure is right above the middle of the bottom. The bottom is 4 spaces long. Only D matches.
It is 2 spaces across and 4 spaces down. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: Priya draws 2 sides of a rectangle. Which dot finishes the rectangle?
items.e: Join both ends to dot D. All 4 corners are square corners.

items.q: Ethan draws 2 sides of a rectangle. Which dot finishes the rectangle?
items.e: Join both ends to dot A. All 4 corners are square corners.
B has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle.
Join both ends to dot C. All 4 corners are square corners and all 4 sides are the same length.
D has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle, even when it is turned.

items.q: Ali draws 2 sides of a square. Which dot finishes the square?
items.e: Join both ends to dot B. All 4 corners are square corners and all 4 sides are the same length.
Each side goes 2 across and 1 up or down, so all 4 sides are the same length. The corners are square corners. It is a square.
It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. A quarter circle has a curved side.
The figure has 3 steps, each 1 space. Only A is the same.
The figure is 3 spaces long and 2 spaces tall. Only A is the same. Count the spaces, not the dots.
C has the same roof and the same walls. One wrong copy has no roof, and others are too tall or too big.
D has the same top and the same middle part as the figure. Check each side, one at a time.
C has 4 sides that are each 3 spaces long. It is a square. The shape 4 spaces long and 3 spaces tall is a rectangle.
A stands on a corner. Its 4 sides are the same length and its corners are square corners. It is a square. The thin one is not.
